title: CaPU v0.16 — Causally Bound Architectural Execution Resumption
scope: bounded reduced-width recovery of a minimal architectural context (PC, four GPRs and status) coupled by one accepted recovery epoch to the already-verified v0.15 causal/replay local STORE runtime

workflow.name: CaPU vCML Architectural Causal Resume v0.16

runtime_invariants: RESTORE_ACCEPT => NEXT_LIVE_ARCH_STATE == ACCEPTED_ARCH_SNAPSHOT && NEXT_LIVE_CAUSAL_STATE == ACCEPTED_CAUSAL_SNAPSHOT && LIVE_EPOCH == ACCEPTED_EPOCH
deterministic_paths: architectural epoch 0x11 with causal epoch 0x12 is split-state rejected
accepted epoch 0x21 restores PC 0x40, GPR1 0x80, GPR2 0x55, status 0xA5, causal head 0x2201, GEN 6 and SEAL 0
otherwise-valid continuation at wrong PC 0x41 is rejected
exact continuation at restored PC 0x40 uses restored GPR1/GPR2 as visible STORE address/data
visible retirement advances causal head to 0x2202 GEN 7 and architectural PC exactly once
pre-recovery speculative STORE cannot retire after recovery and restore of a different epoch/state
formal_driven_fixes: recovery_begin has strict priority over simultaneous restore_valid so a snapshot cannot be falsely reported accepted while sequential recovery clears state
memory_write_enable and vcml_event_valid are masked across recovery/restore so a pre-boundary retirement pulse cannot cross the visible-effect barrier
formal shadow model preserves a newly admitted STORE when its admission overlaps the registered retirement pulse of the previous STORE

workflows: CaPU vCML Full Causal Checkpoint v0.14
CaPU vCML Live Causal Resume v0.15
CaPU vCML Architectural Causal Resume v0.16

upstream_assumption: the causal/replay component is an already accepted v0.15 recovery snapshot; the modeled architectural component carries the same accepted recovery epoch
claim_boundary: bounded reduced-width local STORE execution-recovery proof; matching accepted recovery epochs are enforced at runtime, but v0.16 does not yet prove that PC/GPR/status are cryptographically included in the upstream v0.14 checkpoint digest or anchor commitment and does not prove full ISA/register-file/CSR/exception/interrupt/privilege/load-memory-order/cache/TLB/MMU/predictor/coherence/multicore/durable-media/distributed/unbounded correctness
